WHAT'S USUALLY BROKEN

Five leaks, in almost every company

Different industries. Same pathology.

  1. 01

    Your CRM is a graveyard, not a system of record.

    Fields nobody fills in. Stages nobody agrees on. Reporting nobody trusts.

  2. 02

    You're measuring activity, not signal.

    Emails sent. Posts published. Meetings booked. None of it tells you which behaviors actually predict revenue.

  3. 03

    Your outbound sounds like everyone else's outbound.

    Same tools, same templates, same personalization tokens. Buyers pattern-match it into the trash in under a second.

  4. 04

    Your discovery call isn't a process.

    Every rep runs it differently. Nothing is captured consistently. You can't improve what you can't compare.

  5. 05

    Your content is built for search engines, not buyers.

    Ranking for terms your buyers don't use, while the questions they actually ask go unanswered.

Finding these is the easy part. Fixing them is the work.
